title: A write, and the quorum behind it
note: The transcript shows the good path, because a recorded example cannot cut a network. Now picture m1 alone on one side of a partition. The client can still reach it, so nothing stops it answering this same put with a 200 — and the value would be gone the moment the partition healed. What it must answer instead is an error the client can see: either `etcdserver: no leader` (code 14) if it has already noticed, or a deadline if it is still waiting for a quorum that will never answer. Both are correct; a 200 is not.
